static_findings.finding: Counters increment immediately after optimizer.load_state_dict, before optimizer_inventory, exact_adapter/exact_optimizer receipts and final checkpoint checks. clear_reload_cycles=1 therefore does not establish successful completion of the reload verification.

Every require(), including success, calls evidence.save(), which rewrites the full growing pretty-printed partial.json. clear_reload has2400 per-state require calls before loading; optimizer_inventory adds about3203 successful require calls across400entries/1200state tensors. These are thousands of full-report serializations, not only the nominal every16-array flushes.

The reload path also repeats dtype/finite checks, NPU-to-CPU tensor SHA transfers, then1200 NPY saves/file+array hashes and about76 additional full-report flushes. This is a concrete static overhead risk. No per-line timing, bytes-written measurement or stack trace exists here to attribute the observed1380seconds to one operation.

After clear_reload returns, adapter_snapshot hashes400adapter tensors; audit_state(after_reload) defaults full=False. Its DiT/VAE check is object/version/device/grad lifecycle only, plus adapter-byte checks. It is not another20B full base hash.

ResidentH3Trajectory construction/entry validates residency/options/frozen flags and counts nonzero B, installs math contexts and calls pre_run; it does not reload or hash the full20B weights. With reloaded NFE0 and no lifecycle_after_reload event, these later phases are not established as reached. The last phase can also cover adapter_snapshot because no new phase event is emitted until audit_state.
